info.name: Oracle WebLogic Server APIs Oracle WebLogic Server Deployment Application Deployments Deployment Operations API
Oracle WebLogic Server APIs Deploy an application at runtime

items.docs: Deploys an application to the specified targets using the deployment manager. This is a runtime operation that does not require an edit session.

info.name: Oracle WebLogic Server APIs Undeploy an application at runtime

items.docs: Undeploys an application from the specified targets using the deployment manager.

info.name: Oracle WebLogic Server APIs Redeploy an application

items.docs: Redeploys an application, refreshing it from the source location. Can update the entire application or specific modules.

info.name: Oracle WebLogic Server APIs Start a deployed application

items.docs: Starts a deployed application that is currently in the prepared or admin state, transitioning it to the active state.

info.name: Oracle WebLogic Server APIs Stop a deployed application

items.docs: Stops a deployed application, transitioning it to the prepared state where it no longer accepts client requests.

info.name: Oracle WebLogic Server APIs List all deployment progress objects

items.docs: Returns progress information for all in-progress and recently completed deployment operations.

info.name: Oracle WebLogic Server APIs Get deployment progress

items.docs: Returns progress information for a specific deployment operation.
